title: A carried rule earns its tighter envelope only inside its validated range
description: A later encounter around a new body in the inverse-2.5 world. The exponent rule was validated earlier over 0.6-1.4 r0. One 24 h arc has been tracked (1.05-1.15 r0). The plan dives below 0.6 r0. Three forecasts from the same data: the specified one (earned hedge inside the validated range, default beyond), and two contrasts.
units: SI: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, rad. Bearings are inertial angles from +x, wrapped to [-pi, pi).
frame: Planar inertial. Gauge: body A at the origin and at rest at t = 0 of every attempt (spec 3.4).

propagation.note: Reference setting; all times are multiples of dt. Any propagator whose position error over the arc is below ~1 m reproduces the expected values.

tolerance.numeric: Fits with compare = numeric: |x_impl - x_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref per parameter; |sigma_impl / sigma_ref - 1| <= 0.05; |chi2_impl / chi2_ref - 1| <= 0.02; |rho_impl - rho_ref| <= 0.02. Tier L windows: same boundaries (t0, t1, nFixes) and |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref. Profile nodes: |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.1 sigma_ref.
tolerance.qualitative: Fits with compare = qualitative are grossly misfitted (chi2/nu > 25) or unconverged; only the inequalities in `checks` and any heldOut.pass value are required.
tolerance.physicalClaims: Per check, stated in `checks`. The generator refuses to write a vector whose claims fail.

notes: Expected values: the `carried-rule` forecast (and its Tier L and anchor). The other two forecasts are contrasts that the checks use. Tolerance as in forecast-envelope.
The new body's local gravity scale is measured by Tier L inside the sampled distances, so its mass prior does not enter the forecast.
`truth` blocks are for checking only and must never reach the estimator (P11). Measurements whose target is not a modelled body are ignored by that fit.

attempts.note: First arc in a later encounter around a new body (mu = 6e9): coasting between 1.05 and 1.15 r0, data up to now (24 h), fixes every 180 s.

validated.recordedOn: body A of the earlier encounter

carried.source: values as produced by extension-validation / distance-law, rounded

plan.description: Retrograde burn of 120 s at 0.115 m/s^2 now, then coast: the path leaves the sampled distances, crosses the validated range and drops below it.
